name: n8n_health_contracts_20261010
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_HEALTH_CONTRACTS (2026-10-10, operator ~16:45 ET): every n8n lane / generic workflow / host
monitor has an N8nHealthContract@v1 in config/n8n_health_contracts.json (purpose, connects_to, healthy /
degraded / failed, baseline, alerting, remediation); scripts/check_n8n_health_contracts.py fails a lane that
enters shadow/canary/cutover without one, and canary/cutover need a REVIEWED contract. Hermetic: tmp ledger.
2026-10-12: the 66 grandfathered DRAFT contracts are tested in place. Status stays DRAFT.
2026-11-05: test_self_heal_fixer_shadow_contract_20261105.py pins the D11 shadow lane's REVIEWED contract and
its dry_run dispatch block, and proves the weekday-only lane's declared cadence does not report ORPHANED in
the evening or at the weekend when every scheduled fire succeeded.
